advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Normalize parsedate_to_datetime's result to timezone-aware (or wrap the subtraction) in _retry_after_delay so naive HTTP-dates fall through to the jittered fallback instead of raising TypeError.
evidence: 95:    try:
96:        retry_time = parsedate_to_datetime(retry_after)
97:    except (TypeError, ValueError):
98:        return None
99:    wait_seconds = (retry_time - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).total_seconds()
email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime returns a naive datetime when the input has a '-0000' zone or no zone; subtracting an aware datetime raises TypeError, which is NOT caught here.
Original code delegated HTTP-date handling to pydantic_ai.retries.wait_retry_after (removed in this diff), so this crash path is newly introduced.
86:    response = getattr(exc, "response", None)
87:    headers = getattr(response, "headers", None)
Prior removed code guarded on `if isinstance(exc, httpx.HTTPStatusError):` before reading retry-after.
advisory.finding: _retry_after_delay subtracts datetime.now(timezone.utc) (aware) from parsedate_to_datetime's result at line 99, but parsedate_to_datetime can return a NAIVE datetime for HTTP-dates carrying '-0000' or no zone; the subtraction then raises an uncaught TypeError (the try/except at 95-98 only wraps the parse, not the arithmetic), crashing the tenacity wait callback and failing the retry instead of falling through to the jittered fallback.
merged_from: _retry_after_delay now honors a Retry-After header on ANY exception carrying a .response with headers, whereas the prior code only inspected httpx.HTTPStatusError; a non-status exception that happens to expose a response object could now steer the wait strategy off the intended jittered fallback.
scenarios: A 429/503 response whose Retry-After is an HTTP-date without an explicit numeric offset (e.g. 'Wed, 21 Oct 2026 07:28:00 -0000') during retry backoff.
advisory.suggested_fix: After parsing, if retry_time.tzinfo is None set retry_time = retry_time.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc), or move the subtraction inside a try/except returning None on TypeError.
